items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: junit_failures now reads a bounded, strict-UTF-8 report, refuses DOCTYPE/ENTITY and parses with ET.fromstring; same shape as suite_failed_only._parse. No dependency, no nosemgrep.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: OSError, UnicodeDecodeError and ParseError all map to an empty failure set; oversize reads as unreadable.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Closes the XML entity-expansion door for the use-defused-xml-parse finding; no secrets or user input involved.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New test covers valid, DTD-bearing, garbled, non-UTF-8 and oversized reports against outcomes.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One bounded file read (8 MB cap); no loops over I/O.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Helper _junit_root and _MAX_XML_BYTES mirror the precedent names; probes file 205 lines, test file 136.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumes pytest's own JUnit file; no serialized format changed.
